atoms.text: The American Civil War started after 11 Southern states decided to separate from the United States. That’s why the war is also called “War between the States”. The war started in 1861 and ended in 1865.
atoms.sound: The American Civil War started after 11 Southern states decided to separeight from the United States. That’s why the war is also called “War between the States”. The war started in 1861 and ended in 1865.

hint.text: to separate from sth. – sich von etwas trennen

atoms.a: Die Nord- und Süd-Staaten hatten unterschiedliche Meinungen zum Thema Sklaverei.
atoms.b: The Northern and Southern states had ((++different the_same)) opinions on the topic of slavery.

atoms.a: Während die Süd-Staaten Sklaverei unterstützten, lehnten die Nord-Staaten sie ab.
atoms.b: While the Southern states ((++supported disliked)) slavery, the Northern states rejected it.

atoms.a: Die Süd-Staaten hatten viele Baumwoll-Farmen, die auch Plantagen genannt werden. Afroamerikanische Sklaven wurden gezwungen, auf diesen Farmen zu arbeiten.
atoms.b: The Southern states had many cotton ((++farms schools)) that are also called plantations. African American ((++slaves news_reporter)) were forced to work on these farms.

atoms.a: Über die Jahre wollten immer mehr Gebiete den Vereinigten Staaten beitreten. Dies führte zu Spannungen zwischen Norden und Süden, da entschieden werden musste, ob die neuen Staaten Sklaverei erlauben dürfen oder nicht.
atoms.b: Over the years, more territories wanted to be part of the ((++United_States United_Kingdom)). This created tension between the Northern and Southern states, because it had to be decided if the new states would ((++allow ban)) slavery or not.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.a: 1860 wurde Abraham Lincoln der 16. Präsident der Vereinigten Staaten. Er war gegen die Sklaverei.
atoms.b: In 1860, Abraham Lincoln became the 16th ((++president coloniser)) of the United States. He was against slavery.

atoms.a: Die Süd-Staaten hatten Angst, dass Abraham Lincoln Sklaverei aus den Vereinigten Staaten verbannen wollte.
atoms.b: The Southern states ((++were_afraid were_happy)) that Abraham Lincoln wanted to ban slavery for the entire United States.

atoms.a: Deshalb entschieden sich die Süd-Staaten dazu, aus den Vereinigten Staaten auszutreten und ein eigenes Land zu gründen. Sie nannten sich fortan „Konföderierte Staaten“.
atoms.b: That’s why the Southern states ((++decided argued)) to ((++separate_from stay_within)) the United States and found their own country. They called themselves the “Confederate States”.

atoms.a: On which topic did the Northern and Southern states have different opinions?
b: They had different opinions on the topic of colonisation.
++They had different opinions on the topic of slavery.
They had different opinions on the topic of industries.
None of the states supported slavery.

atoms.a: Who became president of the United States in 1860?
Why did the southern states leave the United States?
b: ++They were afraid that Abraham Lincoln wanted to ban slavery.
They were afraid that the northern states wanted to take over the cotton farms.
They were afraid that Abraham Lincoln wanted to leave the country.

atoms.text: During the Civil War, the Union states and territories fought against the Confederate states. While the Confederate states had better military leaders, the Union states had more people, industries and railroads. By the end of May 1865, all armies from the Confederate states surrendered and the Union states won the war. As a result of the war, African American slaves were freed.

atoms.text: The time after the war, from 1865 to 1877, is called “Reconstruction”. The Union states and the Confederate states worked together to unite again. Before the Southern states could join the United States again, they had to approve the 14th amendment. This was to protect the freed slaves.

hint.sound: reconstruction <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Wiederaufbau.</voice> to unite <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet vereinigen.</voice> to approve something <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet etwas anerkennen.</voice> amendment <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Änderungsgesetz.</voice>

example.b: Every person who is born in the United States or became a U.S. citizen is granted citizenship and equal civil and legal rights.
example.sound: The 14th amendment says that every person who is born in the United States or became a U.S. citizen is granted citizenship and equal civil and legal rights.

atoms.text: An additional 15th amendment was also created to give the freed slaves more rights.

hint.text: Women only got the right to vote in 1920.
hint.sound: Women only got the right to vote in 1920.

example.b: Every (male) citizen of the United States has the right to vote.
example.sound: The 15th amendment says that every male citizen of the United States has the right to vote.

atoms.a: What did the Confederate states have to do before they were allowed to join the United States again?

b.sound: They had to approve the 14th amendment.
They had to apologise to all the citizens.
They had to throw a tea-party.
The 14th amendment says that every person who is born in the United States or became a US citizen is granted citizenship and equal civil and legal rights.
The 14th amendment says that every animal that is born in the United States is granted enough space to grow.
The 14th amendment says that every person who is born in the United States or became a US citizen is granted free burgers and fries.

atoms.text: Even though African Americans got more rights, those living in Southern states were still poor. A lot of them ended up working on farms for low pay. They were also confronted with people who didn't agree with the new rights for African Americans:

example.b: The terrorist group was founded after the Civil War. They wanted to frighten the freed slaves and take away their rights again. The Ku Klux Klan killed several African Americans.
example.sound: The Ku Klux Klan is a terrorist group that was founded after the Civil War. They wanted to frighten the freed slaves and take away their rights again. The Ku Klux Klan killed several African Americans.
